claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: QX-222 is a quaternary local anesthetic that blocks nicotinic acetylcholine receptor channels and voltage-gated sodium channels, but at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent in a pooled viability screen.
